_comment: Phase-11 tabular example: a PyTorch MLP (30→8→ReLU→2) trained on min-max-scaled Wisconsin Breast Cancer features (sklearn load_breast_cancer, same split as examples/trees/), exported to breast_cancer_mlp.onnx, loaded through penumbra.load_onnx and quantized via penumbra.Model.quantize. The serialized IR graph is under 'graph'; the 2 logits are the graph output and the client argmaxes them. FHE output must equal these quantized-cleartext logits/labels bit-for-bit under TFHE, and stay within PHASE11_TABULAR_MLP under CKKS.
